content.headline: Your F1 Journey, Together.
content.subheadline: The community-powered platform that helps international students navigate the US F1 visa process — transparently, affordably, together.

content.headline: What is F1visa.Net?
content.body: F1visa.Net is an online community, forum, and resource hub built by international students for international students. We also host in-person events and meetups where available — connecting F1 visa holders across the US to share knowledge, support each other, and navigate the visa journey together.

content.headline: Why F1visa.Net?
content.subheadline: An online community, forum, and resource hub built by international students — with in-person events and meetups where available. Free at point of need. Owned by the community.

features.title: Verified Community Guidance
features.description: Every piece of information reviewed by students who've successfully navigated the F1 visa process.

features.title: Real Peer Support
features.description: Connect with current F1 students from your country, your university, your program.

features.title: Member-Owned Cooperative
features.description: Not a paid consultancy. Owned by members. Free at point of need.

testimonials.quote: Navigating a new world full of opportunities is definitely overwhelming. Connecting to like minded people through F1Visa.net makes things smoother while having reliable stewards is like cherry on top. Excited to be part of this community.
testimonials.author: Nikhil M

testimonials.quote: Moving to the US on an F-1 visa comes with so many challenges beyond just academics — figuring out work authorization, building a career, and finding your path in a completely new environment. F1Visa.net has been that space where I can connect with people who actually understand the journey. Having a community that guides you through the real stuff makes all the difference.
testimonials.author: Mohammed

testimonials.quote: The F-1 journey is more than just studying abroad — it's about figuring out a whole new life from scratch. F1Visa.net gives you that sense of belonging where everyone is going through the same ups and downs. Having this kind of support system honestly makes the entire experience less stressful and more exciting.
testimonials.author: Mohd Rehan Alvi

items.question: Is F1visa.Net free?
items.answer: Yes — completely free at point of need. F1visa.Net is a member-owned cooperative. No paywalls, no consultancy fees.

items.question: Who can join the community?
items.answer: Anyone navigating the F1 visa process — whether you're applying from abroad or already studying in the US.

items.question: How is the information verified?
items.answer: Every guide and resource is reviewed by students who have successfully completed the F1 visa process. Community-sourced, peer-reviewed.

items.question: Is this a replacement for an immigration lawyer?
items.answer: No. F1visa.Net provides community-sourced guidance for educational purposes. For your specific case, always consult a qualified immigration attorney.
